system.description:
Rangers who walk the old green paths and learned the druids' quiet magic along the way.

  • Thorn Snare (1st): once per encounter, when you hit a creature in natural terrain, roots and briars grip it: it makes a Reflex save against your Class Save DC or its speed is 0 until the end of its next turn.
  • Warden's Lore (1st): Advantage on checks to identify plants, animals and natural omens.
  • Nature Magic (5th): you learn two Druid cantrips (three from 13th), with Wisdom as your casting attribute; your spell DC is 10 + half your Ranger level (minimum 1) + your Wisdom modifier. You can also cast any Druid spell with the Ritual tag as a ritual: up to 2nd level at 5th, 3rd at 9th and 4th at 13th, preparing up to your Wisdom modifier + 1 of them each morning.
  • Warden's Communion (10th): once per day, cast Entangle, Barkskin, Spike Growth or Plant Growth without a slot.
